text:
Kara Nguyen: quick design pass on retention presets modal + export metadata. screenshot in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/retention-presets-v2 :mag:
Leo Park: saw it. keyboard flow feels off — presets are visually cards but behave like checkboxes. for a11y they should be radio buttons (aria-checked) if mutually exclusive.
Samir Rao: agreed. also copy nit: 'Retain indefinitely' reads scary to legal. suggest 'Indefinite retention (no automatic deletion)'.
Marta Lopez: small UX ask: we have multiple data classes (embeddings, logs, traces). can the modal let you pick per-class presets? otherwise audits get confusing.
Kara Nguyen: yes — plan is presets + an "apply to" dropdown. default should be org-scoped: e.g., EU-only orgs get EU-default selected. show a tiny region badge: "Enforced: EU-west".
Leo Park: region badge needs aria-label: "Policy enforced in EU-west" and color contrast >= 4.5:1. current blue is borderline.
Samir Rao: on KMS/encryption: badges currently say 'BYOK' — ambiguous for non-eng reviewers. propose text states: 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' and 'Redwood-managed key'. keep badge short but tooltip verbose.
Marta Lopez: good. also when users change a preset that reduces retention (destructive), add a confirmation with explicit wording: 'This change will delete data older than X days. This cannot be undone.' keyboard focus should land on 'Confirm' button last.
Kara Nguyen: agreed. the confirm modal must use role=dialog and focus trap. toast after change should be aria-live="polite" and read: 'Retention for embeddings set to 30 days. Files older than 30 days will be purged.'
Leo Park: export CSV question: include both human labels and policy ids. header suggestion: 'Policy name','Policy id','Data class','Regions','Encryption'. Keeps legal happy.
Samir Rao: also add an 'export-metadata.json' that includes policy timestamps and enforcement history. easier for compliance requests.
Marta Lopez: UX microcopy: in the presets list, replace 'None' with 'No automatic deletion' to avoid confusion with 'no policy'.
Kara Nguyen: tiny animation note: when switching between "compact" and "comfortable" row density in audit view, preserve keyboard focus and announce change: 'Row density set to compact.'
Leo Park: accessibility detail: retention modal presets should be in a list with role=list and each card role=listitem so screen readers get counts. also indicate which items are editable (aria-disabled=false) vs locked by org policy (aria-disabled=true).
Samir Rao: for KMS badge colors if we change hue, ensure icons remain meaningful (lock vs cloud). don't rely on color alone. aria-hidden for decorative icons and include text in aria-label.
ui-bot: preview: retention-presets-v2 uploaded by @Kara Nguyen 1h5m7s preview: https://staging.redwood.app/retention/presets (expires 48h) :rocket:
Kara Nguyen: will update Figma and the copy doc with the new phrases and aria notes. leaving this open for any final short copy tweaks.
Leo Park: one last: CSV export region cell should list canonical region codes (e.g., eu-west-1) + human label in parentheses to make parsing predictable.
Marta Lopez: adding to copy doc: 'Enforced region shown only if policy scope != global.' small but reduces noise. :memo: 
Samir Rao: thanks all, i'll add the backend fields (policy_id, enforced_regions[], kms_type) to the export schema PR.
Kara Nguyen: thanks. will follow up with the confirm modal mock and example message strings."
